system_notes: CoeliSafe (VerifiedGF-App) is the primary gluten-free safety and verification dining directory application on Cloudflare Pages (https://verifiedgf-app.pages.dev). CRITICAL ARCHITECTURE RULE: In index.html, all restaurant cards (#restaurant-cards-list), map pins, and verified kitchen counters are dynamically rendered at runtime by renderCardsList() from the `const RESTAURANTS = [` array inside <script>. A venue only appears as a full Verified Kitchen card if it has `"verified": true` (or id === 0). When adding, editing, or removing a restaurant (e.g., in Szeged, Budapest, etc.), ALWAYS insert/modify/remove the restaurant object inside `const RESTAURANTS = [` with `"verified": true`, appropriate `"region"` ("midlands" for Szeged & Csongrád, "london" for Budapest, "north" for Debrecen & East, "south" for Pécs/Győr/Balaton), `"coords": [lat, lng]`, `"badges"`, `"protocols"`, and `"menu"`.
